output.title: New optional cert-manager controller flag for annotation copying
output.content: The upgrade introduces a new controller flag `--extra-certificate-annotations` that allows copying annotations from Ingress or Gateway resources to Certificate objects. The environment has cert-manager installed with the `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` CRD in use. After upgrading to v1.18.0, this flag will be available to configure. Inspect whether your cert-manager controller Deployment uses Ingress or Gateway resources for certificate provisioning, and review the release notes to determine if this annotation-copying feature is useful for your use cases.
